title: A.C. Vests and UV Parasols: East Asia Deploys Heat-Fighting Gadgets
summary_full: The innovations include air-conditioned apparel, refrigerators for humans and hand-held fans that use the science behind semiconductors. Governments are making cooling devices central to heat adaptation.
